pages.text: Sand, gravel, anvils and concrete powder share a falling rule that can leave a trace on both sides of an End portal. They share one gravity mimic.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Eye of Ender$(br)Sticky Piston$(br)Slime Block$(br)Rune Plate: Spatial Transfer$(br)Rune Plate: Moving Blocks$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation

pages.title: Choose a Material
pages.text: Use any material in this family as the reference when shaping the common mimic.$(br2)Craft that mimic together with a matching block, in either order, to select what it generates.$(br2)Craft the bound mimic alone to recover both the common mimic and the original material.
